analysis.reasonEn: Following the previous buy decision, RSI exited oversold but failed to secure above 50, remaining in neutral territory. MACD histogram shows improvement but stays negative, not yet a strong bullish signal. Despite 5 consecutive daily gains, price is below the 20-day MA ($2,344.16), facing resistance. Upside potential is limited. Therefore, a wait-and-see approach is warranted for trend confirmation.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($2,315.74) vs SMA5/20/50 ($2,272.63/$2,344.16/$2,504.42): Short-term uptrend, facing mid-term downtrend resistance.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($2,355.92/$2,156.26): Mid-to-long term trend shows weak dominance.
· 52-week position (37.6%) + Current price range near historical lows.

· MACD Histogram Trajectory (1.3053 → 1.3053): Improving within negative territory, weak signal for bearish reversal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $2,344.16): Bandwidth narrowing to 11.81%, indicating consolidation.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($2,254.7): Support based on 20-day Moving Average.
· Swing Resistance ($2,384.47): Potential for further upside on breaking 5-day high.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low, Higher Low): Sideways consolidation continues.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.14x): Moderate confidence in current price action.
· Current Stage Diagnosis (Accumulation): Requires observing 20-day MA breakout and RSI holding above 50 for entry.
